name: default
title: Azteriisk Personal Desktop (Omarchy + Hyprland)
description: Complete personal desktop configuration featuring Omarchy shell, custom plugins, Hyprland Wayland compositor, starship prompt, and terminal tooling.
author: Azteriisk

post_apply: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl --user daemon-reload || true; fi
if command -v omarchy-shell >/dev/null 2>&1; then omarchy-shell shell reloadConfig 2>/dev/null || true; omarchy-shell shell rescanPlugins 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if command -v hyprctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then hyprctl reload 2>/dev/null || true; fi
